title: be going to 表将来
unitTitle: Module 9 I'm going to do the long jump 打算与志向

questions.question: 「我打算参加跳远。」的英文是（　）
options: I'm going to do the long jump.
I going to do the long jump.
I'm going to does the long jump.
I'm go to do the long jump.
questions.answer: I'm going to do the long jump.

questions.question: be going to 中的 to 后面接（　）
be going to 表示「打算、将要」。

knowledge.core_concept: be going to + 动词原形，表示打算/将要做的事。主语决定 be：I am going to… / He is going to…
knowledge.key_formula: I'm going to do the long jump.
common_mistakes: going to 后接三单或过去式。
